method: Original 16 fully paired fixtures, including the same original 12 PR171 keys and four repaired extra-a fixtures. Separate held-out eight games = four dependent home/away design blocks with reserved seeds/new clubs/XIs/formations/styles. No tuning against either final cohort. Reused seeds/mirrors are not independent population replicates. Concurrent cohort wall time is completion data, not CPU cost.
uncertainty: Small dependent samples, strong family effects, branching deterministic trajectories and 90+ minutes of compound effects. Report every paired delta. No calibrated population realism or general causal improvement claim.
